tiger.name: Tiger's Valley Watch
tiger.line: Patience, brothers. We observe the currents before striking.

kite.name: Kite River General
kite.line: We secure the middle ford and prepare for careful engagement.

rhino.name: Rhino's River Guard
rhino.line: Hold the West Ford, watch the kite and orchid movements. Patience is strength.

orchid.name: Orchid River General
orchid.line: Patience, observe the currents. Our strength lies in the valley's hidden paths.
